notes.title: UPDATE MECH ACADEMY (0.5.0)
notes.content:
Hi to all the players!

The latest unmissable Mech Academy update is finally here! 

In addition to new dialogue- and animation-rich scenes, Russian and Spanish translations and voice acting in sex scenes are officially available. 

Are you ready to discover the new moves you'll face in Section Two as you await the final act in the war on Noxa?

Get ready to forge new bonds and experience breathtaking adventures that will bring you closer and closer to your travelling companions. 

Thanks to this new update, you'll be able to experience some of the spiciest situations in the entire game first-hand.  

In particular, you'll be able to help Irina overcome the trauma of her encounter with the female Noxa: if you make the right decisions, the most unique experience since your adventure on 2175 Earth will await you.

But this will not be your only concern. Commander Elara Sardana, in fact, is eager to punish you every chance she gets. You will have the chance to take revenge in many ways, all of them very entertaining. 

The war with the Noxa Empire can wait a little longer, the fun can't!

What are you waiting for? Dive into the new Mech Academy adventures now to continue this crazy and sexy journey of spectacular space battles and exciting female warriors. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633270/f4087344270306aa349a26c641fa175903a12a97.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE FOR MECH ACADEMY (v.0.4.18)
notes.content:
Hi to all the players! 

In the new update, the following have been added:
- 19,000 words
- 1,002 images
- 20 animations

The atmosphere is relaxed at Section Two: after a long time, the main character can finally embrace an old acquaintance.

After gaining experience in the fight against Noxatum, he also receives a visit from Professor Hoffman, who wants to know more about the main character past and to establish an effective strategy against the Noxa fleet.

Meanwhile, Irina asks the main character for help to finish fixing her antique car. The two have a chance to celebrate the repair.

But there is more than just work within the Academy. Thanks to Mei, the main character secretly reaches the Old City, where he can finally return to celebrate as he did in the twentieth century. The two, however, have to deal with the surveillance of Drana. It will be an opportunity to finally experience the more "human" side of the Vorlanian.

The night at the Old City, however, allows an enemy to follow the pilots to Section Two, where he will endanger the lives of all and, in particular, that of Irina.

In the end, the group of pilots gets a chance to meet a flesh-and-blood Noxa for the first time. It will be a decisive moment to understand the mentality and intentions of the enemy fleet.

Concerned about the instability in Section Two, Hoffman recommends that the main character must be kept safe. Drana offers to host him in her room, despite the protests of a jealous Elara. Here, over a regenerating Vorlanian cocktail, the two will have the opportunity to enter even more intimacy.

Afterwards, the main character can relax in the pool together with Lydia, who is very curious about Drana’s hospitality towards her.
Unfortunately, peace is being broken once again. Elara has discovered who is responsible for the enemy’s presence within Section Two. He then decides to punish the main character, a source of bother for the girls.

Ended up in isolation, the main character is afraid of getting bored. Elara, however, will spice up his residence: she will be willing to do anything to win back his friendship.

Once the punishment is served, the main character realizes that Irina has disappeared from sight: he will go to visit her, on the advice of Valentina. What he will find in her room will be quite unexpected.


Follow our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2593850]community page[/url] to be updated on news and the status of the game.
